title: Aerial Wildfire Suppression Planning with a Hybrid CNN-Cellular Automata Fire Model
abstract: arXiv:2606.13633v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Aerial wildfire suppression requires decisions about when, where, and how to deploy limited aircraft. We present an intervention-design framework built on a frozen hybrid convolutional neural network and cellular automaton (CNN-CA) simulator trained jointly on six historical wildfires. First, we jointly optimize binary drop execution and continuous location and orientation, with aircraft-specific footprints, wind drift, and availability, turnaround, and grounded-day constraints. Second, we model water as an immediate transfer of burning probability to the unburned state and retardant as a persistent reduction in the fuel contribution to spread. Third, we remove drops by a rollout-verified backward elimination while limiting degradation in selected fire-performance metrics. translated_title: 基于混合CNN-元胞自动机火灾模型的空中野火扑救规划
translated_abstract: 空中野火扑救需要决策何时、何地以及如何部署有限的飞机资源。我们提出了一个干预设计框架，该框架构建于一个冻结的混合卷积神经网络与元胞自动机（CNN-CA）模拟器之上，该模拟器在六场历史野火数据上联合训练。首先，我们联合优化二元投放执行决策与连续的位置和朝向参数，同时纳入飞机特定的投放覆盖范围、风漂移效应，以及可用性、周转和地面停机天数等约束条件。其次，我们将水建模为燃烧概率向未燃烧状态的即时转移，而将阻燃剂建模为燃料对火势蔓延贡献的持续性降低。第三，我们通过经滚动验证的反向消元方法移除冗余投放，同时限制所选火灾性能指标的退化。第四，我们在每日状态采样和空间相关的模型偏差扰动条件下评估固定调度方案的鲁棒性。第五，我们将优化器与……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于混合CNN-元胞自动机模拟器的空中野火扑救干预设计框架，通过联合优化灭火剂投放的执行决策、位置与朝向，区分水与阻燃剂的不同作用机制，并结合投放移除优化和鲁棒性评估来规划有限的飞机资源。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an intervention-design framework for aerial wildfire suppression built on a hybrid CNN-cellular automata simulator, jointly optimizing drop execution, location, and orientation while modeling distinct water and retardant mechanisms, performing rollout-verified drop elimination, and evaluating schedule robustness.
